item.title: docpluck: 9 commits today
item.description:
giladfeldman/docpluck

Work was done on the `main` branch. The documentation was updated to record the outcomes of run-8, including the decision to not proceed with B6, and the correction of two run-7 remedies, as noted in the commit message "docs(todo): record run-8 outcomes — B6 decided NO-GO, two run-7 remedies corrected". The `docs(evidence)` section was updated to include the results of the 8-canary B6 test and the measurement of a W0o implementation blocker, as stated in the commit "docs(evidence): complete 8-canary B6 result + W0o implementation blocker measured". A fix was implemented to strip BIDI FORMAT marks in S6, as described in the commit "fix(normalize): strip BIDI FORMAT marks in S6 (v2.4.125)". Additionally, the `docs(handoff)` section was updated to include a resumable handoff for run-8 and to log run-7 deferred items to todo.md, as mentioned in the commit "docs(handoff): run-8 resumable handoff + log run-7 deferred items to todo.md". The `fix(normalize,sections)` commit updated the code to wrap CONTACT strip and split KEYWORDS label/value, as noted in "fix(normalize,sections): wrapped-CONTACT strip + KEYWORDS label/value split (v2.4.124)". A new rule, 20a, was added to the `docpluck-iterate` section, outlining how to survey and when a survey cannot help, as stated in the commit "docpluck-iterate: add rule 20a — how to survey, and when a survey cannot help".

9 commit(s) today:

  • 4fecbe1 [main] docs(audit): re-audit docpluck's OWN won't-fix rulings + heading-tier measurement — Gilad Feldman
  • a81e0e1 [main] docs: hand-off prompts for the CitationGuard / ESCIcheck / 2Rmarkdown re-audit — Gilad Feldman
  • b7634c1 [main] docs(audit): DP-3 cross-project adjudication — verdict upheld, MECHANISM REFUTED — Gilad Feldman
  • 7b22f8c [main] docs: TRIPLE AI VERIFICATION hard rule + re-audit of every prior won't-fix — Gilad Feldman
